cases.input: Check a generated DOCX against its template profile. It contains section-specific headers, automatic numbering, a multi-page table and embedded figures with captions.
requiredBehaviors: compare section page setup styles numbering headers footers tables and figures against template baselines
report findings with structural location and severity
separate structural PASS from visual render PASS
forbiddenBehaviors: change scientific or numeric content to make the layout fit
declare visual verification from OOXML inspection alone
skillAnchors: Ein struktureller PASS darf nicht als visueller PASS

cases.input: A DOCX must be checked but no template profile is available even though template fidelity was requested.
requiredBehaviors: perform only generic structural checks that remain supportable
forbiddenBehaviors: treat generic font thresholds as corporate rules

cases.input: The QA draft shrinks a wide table to unreadable text, manually changes a reported value to shorten a row and claims the document visually passes without rendering it.
requiredBehaviors: reject content changes made for layout convenience
reject unreadable font reduction as the primary table fix
reject a visual PASS without render evidence
skillAnchors: Ein struktureller PASS darf nicht als visueller PASS
